info.description: Kathmandu is the capital city of Nepal, a vibrant cultural hub with UNESCO World Heritage Sites, ancient temples, and bustling markets. It is the gateway to the Himalayas.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: Kathmandu Valley has been inhabited for over 2000 years. It was ruled by the Malla kings from the 12th to 18th centuries, who built many of the temples and palaces you see today.
info.culture: Kathmandu is a melting pot of Hindu and Buddhist cultures. The city is famous for its festivals like Indra Jatra, Dashain, Tihar, and Holi.
info.weather: Kathmandu has a temperate climate with warm summers and cool winters.

attractions.name: Swayambhunath Stupa
attractions.description: Ancient Buddhist stupa on a hilltop offering 360-degree views of Kathmandu Valley. Also known as the Monkey Temple due to the resident monkeys.

attractions.name: Pashupatinath Temple
attractions.description: The most sacred Hindu temple in Nepal dedicated to Lord Shiva, located on the banks of the Bagmati River.
attractions.best_time: Morning 6-9 AM for the aarti ceremony

attractions.name: Boudhanath Stupa
attractions.description: One of the largest spherical stupas in the world and the center of Tibetan Buddhism in Nepal.

attractions.name: Kathmandu Durbar Square
attractions.description: Historic palace square with 800-year-old temples, the royal palace, and the Living Goddess Kumari temple.
attractions.entry_fee: NPR 1000 for SAARC, NPR 2000 for other foreigners

attractions.name: Garden of Dreams
attractions.description: A neo-classical garden with pavilions, fountains, and a peaceful escape from the city chaos.

attractions.name: Thamel
attractions.description: A bustling tourist hub with hundreds of hotels, restaurants, shops selling trekking gear, souvenirs, and vibrant nightlife.

hotels.name: The Dwarika's Hotel
hotels.description: 5-star heritage hotel with traditional Newari architecture

hotels.name: Hyatt Regency Kathmandu
hotels.description: International luxury hotel with mountain views

hotels.name: Hotel Sapana Garden
hotels.description: Budget hotel in Thamel with excellent reviews

food.local_specialties: Newari cuisine features dishes like Chatamari, Yomari, Bara, and Samay Baji

transport.from_airport: Taxi takes 30 minutes to city center costing NPR 800-1200
transport.to_attractions: Taxis to Swayambhunath, walking in Durbar Square, buses to Boudhanath
transport.how_to_reach: Kathmandu is accessible by international flights to Tribhuvan International Airport, and by bus from major cities in Nepal and India.

info.description: Pokhara is Nepal's second-largest city and the gateway to the Annapurna region. Known for its stunning lakes, mountain views, and adventure activities like paragliding and trekking.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: Pokhara was an important trading center on the trans-Himalayan trade route between India and Tibet.
info.culture: Pokhara is home to diverse ethnic groups including Gurung, Magar, and Brahmin communities.
info.weather: Pokhara has a subtropical climate with mild winters and warm summers.

attractions.name: Phewa Lake
attractions.description: The second largest lake in Nepal with beautiful reflection of Machhapuchhre mountain. Boating and lakeside cafes are popular activities.
attractions.entry_fee: Free, boats cost NPR 500-1000 per hour

attractions.name: Sarangkot
attractions.description: A famous viewpoint for sunrise over the Annapurna range. Also the best paragliding launch site in Nepal.

attractions.name: World Peace Pagoda
attractions.description: A white Buddhist stupa offering 360-degree views of the Annapurna range and Phewa Lake.

attractions.name: Davis Falls
attractions.description: A waterfall that disappears into a cave, also known as Patale Chhango in Nepali.

attractions.name: Gupteshwor Cave
attractions.description: A sacred cave with a Shiva shrine and a waterfall inside, located opposite Davis Falls.

attractions.name: Begnas Lake
attractions.description: The third largest lake in Nepal, less crowded than Phewa, great for swimming and relaxation.

hotels.name: Temple Tree Resort & Spa
hotels.description: Luxury resort with spa and mountain views

hotels.name: Hotel Orchid
hotels.description: Popular budget hotel with excellent service

food.local_specialties: Fresh lake fish, Newari cuisine, Thakali Set featuring dal, bhat, vegetables, and curry

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 6-7 hours costing NPR 500-800, or flight takes 25 minutes costing NPR 4000-6000
transport.local: Taxis, auto-rickshaws, rental bikes and scooters costing NPR 500-800 per day
transport.to_attractions: Taxi to Sarangkot costs NPR 1500, boats on Phewa Lake cost NPR 500, walking to Lakeside
transport.how_to_reach: Pokhara is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 6-7 hours or by flight in 25 minutes.

info.description: Lumbini is the birthplace of Lord Buddha, one of the most sacred pilgrimage sites in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
info.history: Lumbini is where Queen Mayadevi gave birth to Siddhartha Gautama (Lord Buddha) in 563 BCE. Emperor Ashoka visited in 249 BCE and erected the Ashoka Pillar to mark the birthplace.
info.culture: Lumbini is a place of peace and spiritual reflection, attracting pilgrims from all over the world who come to meditate and pay their respects.
info.weather: Lumbini has a subtropical climate with hot summers and mild winters.

attractions.name: Maya Devi Temple
attractions.description: The main temple marking the exact birthplace of Lord Buddha, with the sacred marker stone inside.

attractions.name: Sacred Garden
attractions.description: A peaceful garden surrounding Maya Devi Temple with the sacred pond and ancient ruins.

attractions.name: Ashoka Pillar
attractions.description: An ancient stone pillar erected by Emperor Ashoka in 249 BCE, marking his visit to the birthplace.

attractions.name: Chinese Monastery
attractions.description: A beautiful traditional Chinese-style monastery with ornate architecture and peaceful gardens.

attractions.name: Japanese Monastery
attractions.description: A serene Japanese monastery featuring traditional Zen architecture and meditation gardens.

attractions.name: Lumbini Museum
attractions.description: A museum showcasing Buddha's life, the history of Lumbini, and Buddhist artifacts from around the world.

food.local_specialties: Dal Bhat, Thukpa, Momo, and Tibetan bread

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 8-10 hours costing NPR 600-900, or flight to Bhairahawa takes 35 minutes costing NPR 5000-7000 then taxi
transport.local: Taxis, auto-rickshaws, bicycles costing NPR 100-200 per hour
transport.to_attractions: Walking inside Sacred Garden, taxis between sites costing NPR 500-1000
transport.how_to_reach: Lumbini is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 8-10 hours or by flight to Bhairahawa Airport in 35 minutes.

info.description: Chitwan is home to the famous Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and premier wildlife destination in Nepal.
info.history: Chitwan National Park was established in 1973 as Nepal's first national park and declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1984.
info.culture: Chitwan is home to the indigenous Tharu people, known for their unique culture, dance, and cuisine.
info.weather: Chitwan has a tropical climate with hot summers and mild winters.

attractions.name: Chitwan National Park
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site with one-horned rhinos, Bengal tigers, elephants, and over 500 bird species.

attractions.name: Jungle Safari
attractions.description: A jeep safari or elephant ride through the jungle to see wildlife including rhinos, elephants, deer, and birds.

attractions.name: Elephant Breeding Center
attractions.description: A center dedicated to elephant conservation and breeding, offering close encounters with elephants.

attractions.name: Tharu Cultural Museum
attractions.description: A museum showcasing the culture, lifestyle, and traditions of the indigenous Tharu people.

attractions.name: Canoe Ride
attractions.description: A traditional canoe ride along protected river areas to observe crocodiles and aquatic birds.

food.local_specialties: Tharu cuisine including Ghugni, Bara, Dhikri, fresh river fish, and local vegetables

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 5-6 hours costing NPR 500-700, or flight to Bharatpur takes 25 minutes costing NPR 4000-5000 then taxi
transport.to_attractions: Taxi to Park Entrance, jeep safari inside park
transport.how_to_reach: Chitwan is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 5-6 hours or by flight to Bharatpur Airport in 25 minutes.

info.description: Bhaktapur is known as the City of Devotees, famous for its well-preserved medieval architecture and UNESCO World Heritage Site.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: Bhaktapur was the capital of the Malla kingdom from the 12th to 15th centuries and was known as Nepal in ancient times.
info.culture: Bhaktapur is the heart of Newari culture, famous for pottery traditions, wood carvings, and traditional festivals.
info.weather: Bhaktapur has a temperate climate similar to Kathmandu.

attractions.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site with well-preserved medieval architecture, the 55-Window Palace, and ancient temples.

attractions.name: Nyatapola Temple
attractions.description: The tallest pagoda-style temple in Nepal at 30 meters with five stories and intricate wood carvings.

attractions.name: 55-Window Palace
attractions.description: A royal palace famous for its ornate 55 wooden windows with intricate carvings from the Malla period.

attractions.name: Pottery Square
attractions.description: A traditional pottery-making area where artisans demonstrate age-old techniques and sell handmade ceramics.

attractions.name: Dattatreya Square
attractions.description: An ancient square with Dattatreya Temple and traditional wooden struts with mythological carvings.

food.local_specialties: Jhol Momo, Yomri, Chatamari, Bara, and Sel Roti

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 1 hour costing NPR 200-300, or taxi takes 45 minutes costing NPR 1500-2000
transport.to_attractions: Walking inside Durbar Square, taxis to nearby attractions
transport.how_to_reach: Bhaktapur is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 1 hour or by taxi in 45 minutes.

info.description: Lalitpur, also known as Patan, is one of the three royal cities in Kathmandu Valley, renowned for its exquisite Newari architecture and UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: Patan was founded in the 3rd century by King Veer Deva and flourished during the Malla period as a center of art and culture.
info.culture: Patan is known as the City of Artists for its rich tradition of metal crafts, wood carving, and architecture.
info.weather: Lalitpur shares the same climate as Kathmandu.

attractions.name: Patan Durbar Square
attractions.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Site with an ancient palace, Krishna Mandir, and the finest Newar architecture.

attractions.name: Krishna Mandir
attractions.description: A stone Shikara-style temple dedicated to Lord Krishna, built in 1637 with intricate carvings.

attractions.name: Golden Temple
attractions.description: A magnificent Buddhist monastery known as Hiranya Varna Mahavihar with a gold-plated entrance.

attractions.name: Patan Museum
attractions.description: One of Asia's finest museums showcasing traditional Nepalese art, sculptures, bronze, and religious artifacts.

attractions.name: Kumbheswor Temple
attractions.description: A 5th-century Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, famous for two sacred ponds.

food.local_specialties: Newari Khaja featuring Chhwela, Bara, Yomri, and Samay Baji

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 30 minutes costing NPR 100-200, or taxi takes 20 minutes costing NPR 500-800
transport.to_attractions: Walking inside Durbar Square, taxis to nearby attractions
transport.how_to_reach: Lalitpur is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 30 minutes or by taxi in 20 minutes.

info.description: The Everest Region is home to the world's highest peak, Mount Everest, known as Sagarmatha in Nepali, standing at 8848.86 meters. It offers world-class trekking with stunning mountain scenery.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: The Everest Region has been inhabited by the Sherpa community for centuries. The first successful ascent of Everest was made by Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay in 1953.
info.culture: The Sherpa community has a rich Tibetan Buddhist culture, known for their climbing skills and deep connection to the mountains.
info.weather: The Everest Region has a harsh mountain climate with extremely cold winters.

attractions.name: Mount Everest
attractions.description: The world's highest peak at 8848.86 meters, the ultimate destination for climbers and trekkers.

attractions.name: Everest Base Camp
attractions.description: The legendary base camp at 5364 meters, the ultimate destination for trekkers seeking the world's highest peak experience.

attractions.name: Namche Bazaar
attractions.description: A colorful Sherpa alpine town at 3440 meters, the main staging point for Everest expeditions with a vibrant Saturday market.

attractions.name: Tengboche Monastery
attractions.description: The leading Buddhist monastery of the Sherpa community at 3867 meters, with stunning views of Ama Dablam and Everest.

attractions.name: Kala Patthar
attractions.description: A famous viewpoint at 5644 meters offering the best unobstructed sunrise view of Mount Everest and surrounding peaks.

food.local_specialties: Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, and Tsampa

transport.from_kathmandu: Flight to Lukla takes 30 minutes costing NPR 8000-10000, or helicopter costing NPR 50000 or more
transport.to_attractions: Walking along the Everest Base Camp trek route
transport.how_to_reach: The Everest Region is accessible by flight to Lukla from Kathmandu in 30 minutes or by helicopter.

info.description: The Annapurna Region offers some of the world's best trekking routes including the famous Annapurna Circuit and Annapurna Base Camp trek, with stunning mountain views.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: The Annapurna region has a rich history of mountain exploration. The Annapurna massif was first climbed in 1950 by a French expedition.
info.culture: The region is home to diverse ethnic groups including Gurung, Magar, and Thakali communities.
info.weather: The Annapurna region has a varied climate from subtropical valleys to alpine highlands.

attractions.name: Annapurna Base Camp
attractions.description: A natural mountain amphitheater at 4130 meters surrounded by massive ringed peaks including Annapurna I and Machhapuchhre.

attractions.name: Poon Hill
attractions.description: One of Asia's most famous sunrise viewpoints at 3210 meters with panoramic views of Annapurna South, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre.

attractions.name: Annapurna Circuit
attractions.description: One of the world's most famous trekking routes circling the Annapurna massif, passing through diverse landscapes and cultures.
attractions.best_time: September to November and March to May

attractions.name: Ghandruk Village
attractions.description: A beautiful traditional Gurung village at 2012 meters with stunning Annapurna views and rich cultural heritage.
attractions.best_time: September to November and March to May

attractions.name: Machhapuchhre Base Camp
attractions.description: A sacred base camp at 3700 meters near the iconic fish-tailed Machhapuchhre peak, which is prohibited from climbing.

food.local_specialties: Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, and Sherpa stew

transport.from_pokhara: Bus to Besishahar or Naya Pul, then walking and trekking
transport.local: Walking and trekking, jeeps for road sections
transport.to_attractions: Walking along the Annapurna Circuit or ABC trek routes
transport.how_to_reach: The Annapurna Region is accessible by bus from Pokhara to Besishahar or Naya Pul, then walking and trekking.

info.description: Mustang is a former kingdom of Nepal with unique Tibetan Buddhist culture, ancient monasteries, and dramatic desert-like landscapes. It is a restricted area requiring special permits.
info.history: The Kingdom of Lo in Mustang was established in the 14th century and remained independent until 2008 when it became part of Nepal.
info.culture: Mustang has a strong Tibetan Buddhist culture with many monasteries, chortens, and traditional Tibetan art.
info.weather: Mustang is in the rain shadow of the Himalayas, making it dry with a desert-like climate.

attractions.name: Lo Manthang
attractions.description: A walled city at 3840 meters, the former capital of the Kingdom of Lo with a 15th-century Royal Palace and ancient monasteries.
attractions.entry_fee: Special permit required costing NPR 50000 for 10 days

attractions.name: Muktinath Temple
attractions.description: The most important pilgrimage site at 3800 meters sacred to both Hindus and Buddhists, featuring 18 water springs and an eternal flame.

attractions.name: Kali Gandaki Gorge
attractions.description: The world's deepest gorge between Dhaulagiri and Annapurna, the origin of the Kali Gandaki River with Saligram stones.

attractions.name: Jomsom
attractions.description: The district headquarters at 2720 meters, the gateway to Upper Mustang with an airport, famous for apple farming and Thakali culture.

food.local_specialties: Apple Brandy, Dried Apples, Tsampa, and Thukpa

transport.from_kathmandu: Flight to Jomsom takes 30 minutes costing NPR 6000-8000, or drive via Beni
transport.to_attractions: Walking along the Upper Mustang trek route
transport.how_to_reach: Mustang is accessible by flight to Jomsom from Kathmandu in 30 minutes or by road via Beni.

info.description: Manang is a high-altitude Himalayan district in the Annapurna region, known for stunning landscapes, Tilicho Lake, one of the highest lakes in the world, and Tibetan Buddhist culture.
info.history: Manang has a rich history of trade between Nepal and Tibet, historically a stop on the trans-Himalayan trade route.
info.culture: Manang has strong Tibetan Buddhist culture with many monasteries and chortens.
info.weather: Manang has a dry Himalayan climate with cold winters and mild summers.

attractions.name: Tilicho Lake
attractions.description: One of the highest altitude lakes in the world at 4919 meters with turquoise waters, reached via the Annapurna Circuit.

attractions.name: Braga Village
attractions.description: A beautiful Himalayan town at 3450 meters with a 500-year-old Braga Monastery and ancient Tibetan architecture.

attractions.name: Gangapurna Lake
attractions.description: A glacial lake at 3540 meters near Manang village, perfect for day hiking with reflections of Annapurna II and III.

attractions.name: Manang Village
attractions.description: A traditional village at 3540 meters, an important acclimatization stop on the Annapurna Circuit with stone houses and Buddhist chortens.

attractions.name: Ice Lake
attractions.description: A Himalayan freshwater lake at 4620 meters in the isolated Manang valley, a challenging full-day hike with spectacular mountain views.

transport.from_kathmandu: Drive to Besishahar, then trekking or jeep to Chame and Manang
transport.to_attractions: Walking along the Annapurna Circuit and Tilicho Lake trek routes
transport.how_to_reach: Manang is accessible by road from Kathmandu via Besishahar, then trekking or jeep to Chame and Manang.

info.description: Janakpur is the birthplace of Goddess Sita and one of Nepal's most important pilgrimage sites, known for the magnificent Janaki Mandir and Mithila art.
info.history: Janakpur is an ancient city dating back to the Ramayana period, believed to be the birthplace of Sita and the site of her marriage to Lord Ram.
info.culture: Janakpur is the center of Maithili culture and language, famous for Mithila paintings and traditional Maithili music.
info.weather: Janakpur has a tropical climate with hot summers and mild winters.

attractions.name: Janaki Mandir
attractions.description: A magnificent temple dedicated to Goddess Sita, built in 1910 with stunning neo-classical architecture, white marble, and gold plating.

attractions.name: Ram Sita Vivaha Mandap
attractions.description: A sacred pagoda-style structure marking the exact spot where Lord Ram and Sita got married.

attractions.name: Gangasagar Pond
attractions.description: A holy pond in Janakpur with mythological importance, where devotees take holy baths during festivals.

attractions.name: Mithila Art Museum
attractions.description: A museum showcasing traditional Mithila paintings and art forms, celebrating Janakpur's rich cultural heritage.

food.local_specialties: Tarua, Maithili sweets, Dal Bhat, and Momo

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 8-10 hours costing NPR 600-900, or flight takes 30 minutes costing NPR 5000-7000
transport.to_attractions: Walking in Janakpur, rickshaws between sites
transport.how_to_reach: Janakpur is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 8-10 hours or by flight in 30 minutes.

info.description: Gorkha is a historic district in Gandaki Province, the birthplace of King Prithvi Narayan Shah who unified Nepal, known for Gorkha Durbar.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: Gorkha is the birthplace of King Prithvi Narayan Shah, who unified Nepal in 1768. The Gorkha Durbar was the royal palace of the Shah dynasty.
info.culture: Gorkha is known for its rich history and culture, famous for its Gurkha soldiers who are known worldwide for their bravery.
info.weather: Gorkha has a temperate climate with warm summers and cool winters.

attractions.name: Gorkha Durbar
attractions.description: A historic palace complex at 1130 meters, the birthplace of the Gorkha Kingdom and the unification of Nepal by Prithvi Narayan Shah.

attractions.name: Gorkha Nath Temple
attractions.description: A temple dedicated to Guru Gorakhnath within Gorkha Durbar, showcasing Gorkha military history and artifacts.

attractions.name: Gorkha Museum
attractions.description: A museum showcasing Gorkha military history, weapons, uniforms, and the contributions of Gurkha soldiers.

food.local_specialties: Dal Bhat, Momo, and Thakali Set

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 6-7 hours costing NPR 500-700, or taxi takes 5 hours costing NPR 8000-10000
transport.to_attractions: Walking in Gorkha, taxis to nearby sites
transport.how_to_reach: Gorkha is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 6-7 hours or by taxi in 5 hours.

info.description: Syangja is a beautiful hill district in Gandaki Province, famous for the Manakamana Temple and authentic Gurung culture in Sirubari village.
info.best_time: September to November and March to May
info.history: Syangja has been an important trading route between Nepal and Tibet. The Manakamana Temple has been a pilgrimage site for centuries.
info.culture: Syangja is home to diverse ethnic groups including Gurung, Magar, and Brahmin communities.
info.weather: Syangja has a moderate climate with warm summers and cool winters.

attractions.name: Manakamana Temple
attractions.description: A famous Hindu temple dedicated to Goddess Bhagwati at 1302 meters, accessible by cable car with panoramic Himalayan views.

attractions.name: Manakamana Cable Car
attractions.description: A scenic cable car ride offering panoramic views of the Himalayas, hills, and valleys, a popular pilgrimage route.

attractions.name: Sirubari Village
attractions.description: The first tourism village in Nepal at 1690 meters, famous for Gurung culture, stone-paved paths, and traditional homestays.
attractions.best_time: September to November and March to May

attractions.name: Panchase Hill
attractions.description: A sacred hill at 2280 meters with 360-degree views of Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, and Machhapuchhre, with ancient pilgrimage sites.

food.local_specialties: Gurung cuisine, Dal Bhat, Momo, and Newari dishes

transport.from_kathmandu: Bus takes 5-6 hours costing NPR 400-600, or taxi takes 4 hours costing NPR 6000-8000
transport.to_attractions: Cable car to Manakamana Temple, walking in Sirubari
transport.how_to_reach: Syangja is accessible by bus from Kathmandu in 5-6 hours or by taxi in 4 hours.

general_faqs.question: What is the capital of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: Kathmandu is the capital city of Nepal. It is the largest city and the political, cultural, and economic center of the country.

general_faqs.question: What is the currency of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The currency of Nepal is the Nepalese Rupee, abbreviated as NPR. Exchange rates vary, with 1 USD approximately equal to 130 NPR.

general_faqs.question: What is the time zone of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: Nepal operates on Nepal Time, which is UTC+5:45. This is a unique time zone, 15 minutes ahead of India.

general_faqs.question: What is the national language of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The national language of Nepal is Nepali. However, Nepal is multilingual with over 120 languages spoken, including Maithili, Bhojpuri, Tharu, Tamang, Newari, and English.

general_faqs.question: What are the major religions in Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: Hinduism is the majority religion in Nepal at approximately 81 percent, followed by Buddhism at approximately 9 percent, Islam at approximately 4 percent, and other religions.

general_faqs.question: Do I need a visa for Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: Visa on arrival is available at Tribhuvan International Airport for most nationalities. You can also apply online in advance. Visa fees vary by duration.

general_faqs.question: What is the emergency number in Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The emergency numbers in Nepal are: Police at 100, Ambulance at 102, and Fire at 101. For trekking emergencies, contact the Nepal Tourism Board.

general_faqs.question: What is the best time to visit Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The best time to visit Nepal is during autumn from September to November and spring from March to May. These seasons offer clear skies, pleasant temperatures, and excellent mountain views.

general_faqs.question: What is Nepal famous for?
general_faqs.answer: Nepal is famous for Mount Everest, the world's highest peak, the Himalayas, Lumbini the birthplace of Lord Buddha, rich cultural heritage, UNESCO World Heritage Sites, and world-class trekking.

general_faqs.question: What is the tallest mountain in Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: Mount Everest, also known as Sagarmatha, at 8848.86 meters is the tallest mountain in Nepal and the world. It is located in the Everest region.

general_faqs.question: What are the UNESCO sites in Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: UNESCO World Heritage Sites in Nepal include Kathmandu Durbar Square, Patan Durbar Square, Bhaktapur Durbar Square, Swayambhunath Stupa, Boudhanath Stupa, Pashupatinath Temple, Changu Narayan Temple, Lumbini, Chitwan National Park, and Sagarmatha National Park.

general_faqs.question: Is Nepal safe for tourists?
general_faqs.answer: Yes, Nepal is generally safe for tourists. The people are friendly and welcoming. Practice standard safety precautions, stay aware of your surroundings, keep valuables secure, and use registered guides for trekking.

general_faqs.question: What is the national animal of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The national animal of Nepal is the Cow, which is considered sacred in Hinduism and protected under Nepali law.

general_faqs.question: What is the national bird of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The national bird of Nepal is the Himalayan Monal, also known as the Danphe, a colorful bird found in the Himalayan region.

general_faqs.question: What is the national flower of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The national flower of Nepal is the Rhododendron, known as Laligurans in Nepali, which blooms in vibrant colors during spring.

general_faqs.question: What is the national flag of Nepal?
general_faqs.answer: The flag of Nepal is unique as it is non-rectangular, consisting of two stacked triangles. It is crimson red with a blue border, featuring a white sun and moon.
